reason: Ursa Major is a Series E rocket-propulsion manufacturer with ~308 employees and $442.7M raised (Nov 2025 Series E of $100M + $50M debt; $115M in 2025 bookings) — vastly too large and too late-stage for a fractional CTO engagement aimed at 8-30 person Series A/B startups, and it is a propulsion hardware/energetics business rather than the AI/ML, geospatial or sensor software niche Barry Hess serves; the matched postings (Senior Contracts Manager, Buyer II, Propulsion Systems Engineer II, Development Technician - Energetics) are scale-up manufacturing and procurement hires, and the Contracts Manager JD explicitly reports to a General Counsel and describes maturing an existing contracts function, which is the opposite of a company missing cleared senior technical leadership. No quotable line redescribes the lab-to-field transition stall he fixes.
